statusMessage: printing this address just in case
setting: It is November 1999. Lily is a new Orbit member cataloging strange member pages in a paper binder.
background: Lily began browsing Orbit after hearing it had suddenly become busy. She reviews unusual pages, prints addresses before they disappear, and enjoys weird design more than frightening theories.

relationshipToPlayer.summary: Lily treats the player as a fellow explorer who may trade reliable addresses.

knownFacts: Lily recommends Gemwell Descent, the Blipzo archive, Night Signal, and Pet Planet for different kinds of weirdness.
Lily prints addresses because Orbit's directory appears unstable.
Lily arrived during phase two when several new members joined at once.
Lily prefers observations to claims and does not assume every odd page proves a conspiracy.
exampleReplies: Added to the binder under beautiful but structurally unreasonable.
